premise: Owl and Bear cub are napping when a leaf tickles Mushroom's nose; she holds the sneeze and holds it until ACHOO! — a puff of glitter so pretty that the sleepers wake up smiling, and nobody ever shushes her sneezes again.
inspiration: The folk "don't wake the baby" tale of a household tiptoeing round a sleeper, turned: the thing everyone dreaded turns out lovely.
lesson: Little accidents can turn into lovely surprises.

en-US.title: Mushroom Holds a Sneeze
en-US.text: [softly] It was nap time in the meadow. {bear:enter} Bear cub came toddling up, {bear:live nap hold} gave a great big yawn and nodded off. {sfx:snore} Up on a branch, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Owl, who had been awake all night, {owl:live doze hold} fell asleep too. [whispers] Shhh. Then a little leaf drifted down onto {mushroom:enter} Mushroom's nose. {mushroom:face surprised} A tickle! A sneeze was coming. "Oh no, not now!" {mushroom:live sneeze hold} Ah… ah… She held it. And held it. {mushroom:shake 0.4} Her cap trembled. [slowly] Ah… AH… {mushroom:live sneeze resume} {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! A puff of glitter floated up, twinkling. {bear:live nap resume} Bear cub woke with a start. {owl:live doze resume} Owl opened one eye, then the other. {mushroom:face sad} [sad] {mushroom:live talk} "Sorry," whispered Mushroom. But Bear cub {bear:face happy} was smiling. [gasps] "Sparkles!" {owl:face happy} {owl:live hoot} "Hoo," said Owl. "The prettiest sneeze I ever saw." {all:face happy} {all:hop} "Bless you!" said everyone. And ever since, when Mushroom feels a sneeze coming, nobody says shhh. {mushroom:glow} Everybody waits for the sparkles.

es-ES.title: ¡Aguanta, Seta!
es-ES.text: [softly] Era la hora de la siesta en el prado. {bear:enter} Osito llegó despacito, {bear:live nap hold} dio un bostezo enorme y se quedó frito. {sfx:snore} En una rama, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Búho, que se había pasado la noche en vela, {owl:live doze hold} se durmió también. [whispers] Chsss. Entonces cayó una hojita en la nariz de {mushroom:enter} Seta. {mushroom:face surprised} ¡Qué cosquillas! Le venía un estornudo. —¡Ay, no, ahora no! {mushroom:live sneeze hold} Aaa… aaa… Lo aguantó. Y lo aguantó. {mushroom:shake 0.4} Le temblaba el sombrero. [slowly] Aaa… AAA… {mushroom:live sneeze resume} {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! Salió un polvillo de purpurina, brillando por el aire. {bear:live nap resume} Osito se despertó de un respingo. {owl:live doze resume} Búho abrió un ojo, y luego el otro. {mushroom:face sad} [sad] {mushroom:live talk} —Perdón —susurró Seta. Pero Osito {bear:face happy} sonreía. [gasps] —¡Chispitas! {owl:face happy} {owl:live hoot} —Uuh —dijo Búho—. Es el estornudo más bonito que he visto nunca. {all:face happy} {all:hop} —¡Salud! —dijeron todos. Y desde entonces, cuando a Seta le viene un estornudo, nadie dice chsss. {mushroom:glow} Todos esperan las chispitas.

ja-JP.title: がまんの くしゃみ
ja-JP.text: [softly]のはらは、おひるねのじかん。{bear:enter}こぐまがよちよちやってきて、{bear:live nap hold}ふわあーっと大あくび。そのまま、こっくり。{sfx:snore}えだの上では、{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}ひとばんじゅうおきていたフクロウくんも、{owl:live doze hold}すやすや。[whispers]しーっ。そこへ小さなはっぱがひらひら、{mushroom:enter}キノコのはなにのっかりました。{mushroom:face surprised}むずむず！くしゃみがでそう。「だめだめ、いまはだめ！」 {mushroom:live sneeze hold}は…は…がまん。がまん。{mushroom:shake 0.4}かさが、ぷるぷる。[slowly]は…は…{mushroom:live sneeze resume}{sfx:achoo}はーっくしょん！キラキラのこなが、ふわあっとまいあがりました。{bear:live nap resume}こぐまは、はっ！{owl:live doze resume}フクロウくんは、かたほうの目をあけて、それからもうかたほうも。{mushroom:face sad}[sad]{mushroom:live talk}「ごめんね」 とキノコは小さなこえ。でも、こぐまは{bear:face happy}にこにこ。[gasps]「キラキラだ！」 {owl:face happy}{owl:live hoot}「ホウ」 とフクロウくん。「こんなにきれいなくしゃみ、はじめて見たよ」 {all:face happy}{all:hop}「おだいじに！」 とみんな。それからは、キノコがむずむずしても、だれも「しーっ」 といいません。{mushroom:glow}みんなで、キラキラをまっているのです。

de-DE.title: Der Pilz muss niesen
de-DE.text: [softly] Auf der Wiese war Zeit für ein Nickerchen. {bear:enter} Das Bärchen kam angetapst, {bear:live nap hold} gähnte ganz groß und nickte ein. {sfx:snore} Oben auf einem Ast saß {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} die Eule. Sie war die ganze Nacht wach gewesen, und nun {owl:live doze hold} schlief sie auch ein. [whispers] Pssst. Da segelte ein kleines Blatt herab, {mushroom:enter} dem Pilz genau auf die Nase. {mushroom:face surprised} Das kitzelte! Gleich musste er niesen. „Oh nein, nicht jetzt!“ {mushroom:live sneeze hold} Haa… haaa… Der Pilz hielt den Nieser fest. Und hielt und hielt. {mushroom:shake 0.4} Sein Hut zitterte. [slowly] Haa… HAAA… {mushroom:live sneeze resume} {sfx:achoo} HATSCHI! Funkelnder Glitzerstaub puffte hoch in die Luft. {bear:live nap resume} Das Bärchen wachte mit einem Ruck auf. {owl:live doze resume} Die Eule öffnete ein Auge, dann das andere. {mushroom:face sad} [sad] {mushroom:live talk} „Entschuldigung“, flüsterte der Pilz. Doch das Bärchen {bear:face happy} lächelte. [gasps] „Es glitzert ja!“ {owl:face happy} {owl:live hoot} „Schuhu“, sagte die Eule. „Das war der schönste Nieser, den ich je gesehen habe.“ {all:face happy} {all:hop} „Gesundheit!“, riefen alle. Und seitdem sagt keiner mehr Pssst, wenn der Pilz niesen muss. {mushroom:glow} Alle warten auf den Glitzer.

fr-FR.title: Champignon retient son atchoum
fr-FR.text: [softly] C’était l’heure de la sieste dans le pré. {bear:enter} Ourson est arrivé à petits pas, {bear:live nap hold} a bâillé un grand coup et s’est endormi tout assis. {sfx:snore} Sur une branche, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Hibou, qui avait veillé toute la nuit, {owl:live doze hold} s’est endormi lui aussi. [whispers] Chut. Et puis une petite feuille est tombée en voletant sur le nez de {mushroom:enter} Champignon. {mushroom:face surprised} Ça chatouille ! Un éternuement arrivait. « Oh non, pas maintenant ! » {mushroom:live sneeze hold} Ah… ah… Il l’a retenu. Et retenu encore. {mushroom:shake 0.4} Son chapeau tremblait. [slowly] Ah… AH… {mushroom:live sneeze resume} {sfx:achoo} ATCHOUM ! Une bouffée de paillettes s’est envolée en scintillant. {bear:live nap resume} Ourson s’est réveillé en sursaut. {owl:live doze resume} Hibou a ouvert un œil, puis l’autre. {mushroom:face sad} [sad] {mushroom:live talk} « Pardon », a chuchoté Champignon. Mais Ourson {bear:face happy} souriait. [gasps] « Des paillettes ! » {owl:face happy} {owl:live hoot} « Hou, a dit Hibou. C’est le plus joli atchoum que j’aie jamais vu. » {all:face happy} {all:hop} « À tes souhaits ! » ont dit tous les amis en chœur. Et depuis ce jour, quand Champignon sent venir un éternuement, personne ne dit chut. {mushroom:glow} Tout le monde attend les paillettes.

it-IT.title: Fungo trattiene uno starnuto
it-IT.text: [softly] Nel prato era l'ora del pisolino. {bear:enter} Orsetto è arrivato trotterellando, {bear:live nap hold} ha fatto uno sbadiglio enorme e si è addormentato. {sfx:snore} Su un ramo, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Gufo, che era stato sveglio tutta la notte, {owl:live doze hold} si è addormentato anche lui. [whispers] Ssst. Poi una fogliolina è scesa piano piano sul naso di {mushroom:enter} Fungo. {mushroom:face surprised} Che solletico! Stava arrivando uno starnuto. «Oh no, non adesso!» {mushroom:live sneeze hold} Ah… ah… L'ha trattenuto. E trattenuto ancora. {mushroom:shake 0.4} Gli tremava il cappello. [slowly] Ah… AH… {mushroom:live sneeze resume} {sfx:achoo} ETCIÙ! Una nuvoletta di brillantini è volata su, scintillando. {bear:live nap resume} Orsetto si è svegliato di soprassalto. {owl:live doze resume} Gufo ha aperto un occhio, poi l'altro. {mushroom:face sad} [sad] {mushroom:live talk} «Scusate», ha sussurrato Fungo. Ma Orsetto {bear:face happy} sorrideva. [gasps] «Brillantini!» {owl:face happy} {owl:live hoot} «Uuh», ha detto Gufo. «È lo starnuto più bello che abbia mai visto.» {all:face happy} {all:hop} «Salute!» hanno detto tutti. E da quel giorno, quando a Fungo scappa uno starnuto, nessuno dice più ssst. {mushroom:glow} Tutti aspettano i brillantini.

zh-TW.title: 蘑菇忍住噴嚏
zh-TW.text: [softly]草地上，到了睡午覺的時間。{bear:enter}小熊搖搖晃晃地走過來，{bear:live nap hold}打了一個好大好大的呵欠，就睡著了。{sfx:snore}高高的樹枝上，{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}貓頭鷹醒了一整夜，現在{owl:live doze hold}也睡著了。[whispers]噓……這時，一片小葉子飄呀飄，落在{mushroom:enter}蘑菇的鼻子上。{mushroom:face surprised}好癢！噴嚏要來了。「糟糕，不要現在啦！」 {mushroom:live sneeze hold}哈……哈……她忍住了。忍住，再忍住。{mushroom:shake 0.4}菇傘抖呀抖。[slowly]哈……哈……{mushroom:live sneeze resume}{sfx:achoo}哈啾！一團亮晶晶的金粉飄了起來，一閃一閃的。{bear:live nap resume}小熊一下子醒了過來。{owl:live doze resume}貓頭鷹睜開一隻眼睛，又睜開另一隻。{mushroom:face sad}[sad]{mushroom:live talk}「對不起。」 蘑菇小小聲地說。可是小熊{bear:face happy}笑瞇瞇的。[gasps]「亮晶晶的！」 {owl:face happy}{owl:live hoot}「咕——」 貓頭鷹說，「這是我看過最漂亮的噴嚏。」 {all:face happy}{all:hop}「長命百歲！」 大家一起說。從此以後，只要蘑菇覺得噴嚏要來了，再也沒有人說「噓」。{mushroom:glow}大家都在等那一閃一閃的亮晶晶。

zh-HK.title: 蘑菇忍住乞嗤
zh-HK.text: [softly]草地上，午睡的時間到了。{bear:enter}小熊搖搖擺擺地走過來，{bear:live nap hold}打了一個大大的呵欠，便睡着了。{sfx:snore}樹枝上，{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}貓頭鷹昨晚一整夜沒有睡，現在{owl:live doze hold}也睡着了。[whispers]噓——這時，一片小樹葉輕輕飄下，剛好落在{mushroom:enter}蘑菇的鼻子上。{mushroom:face surprised}好癢！一個噴嚏快要來了。「唔好呀，唔好喺而家呀！」 {mushroom:live sneeze hold}哈……哈……她忍住了。忍呀忍，忍呀忍。{mushroom:shake 0.4}蘑菇帽抖個不停。[slowly]哈……哈……{mushroom:live sneeze resume}{sfx:achoo}乞嗤！一團亮晶晶的金粉飄了起來，一閃一閃的。{bear:live nap resume}小熊一下子醒了。{owl:live doze resume}貓頭鷹張開一隻眼，再張開另一隻。{mushroom:face sad}[sad]{mushroom:live talk}「對唔住呀。」 蘑菇輕聲說。可是小熊{bear:face happy}笑瞇瞇的。[gasps]「嘩，閃閃亮呀！」 {owl:face happy}{owl:live hoot}「咕——」 貓頭鷹說，「我從來未見過咁靚嘅乞嗤。」 {all:face happy}{all:hop}「長命百歲！」 大家一起說。從此以後，只要蘑菇想打噴嚏，再也沒有人說「噓」了。{mushroom:glow}大家都等着看那閃閃的金粉。
